config.notes: Primary mandate from USER_DIRECTIVES.md and chat on 2026-05-16: make every CQL expression/library supported by the Python translator executable in DuckDB-WASM using only C++ DuckDB extensions and SQL macros. This is broader than the previous browser-demo surface milestone. The design must produce a precise emitted-function inventory and acceptance matrix covering translator-emitted CQL functions, Python UDFs, C++ UDFs, SQL macros, no-Python DuckDB-WASM availability, and parity-test status. Implementation must close every Python-only DuckDB UDF gap that can be emitted by supported CQL, either by C++ implementation or pure DuckDB SQL macro, and must remove or justify all Python shadowing for C++ conflicts only after parity tests pass. Acceptance criteria: strict translate-and-execute no-Python gate for supported arbitrary playground CQL; no missing emitted functions in a C++/macro-only DuckDB-WASM catalog; direct native C++/macro-only tests; browser/WASM e2e tests; all unit and e2e pytest suites relevant to FHIRPath, CQL, ViewDefinition, DQM, and WASM pass; full conformance remains 100% across ViewDefinition, FHIRPath, CQL, and DQM; generated 0.0.6 wheel/WASM/static artifacts are refreshed if implementation changes package or browser release outputs. Because this affects DuckDB registration, bundled native extensions, public UDF behavior, wheel contents, WASM artifacts, and release behavior, a Release Engineer artifact gate is required before final completion even though the configured pipeline ends with evolution.

completion.summary: Implemented and verified CQL DuckDB-WASM no-Python runtime parity for translator-supported CQL. Strict native no-Python execution of the official CQL XML suite passes 1706/1706, and full project conformance remains 2822/2822.
